soc_asymmetric.name: MARKETS WIT ASYMMETRIC INFORMATION
soc_asymmetric.desc: THREE MODELS OF EXCHANGE IN WHICH ONE PARTY IZ BETTER INFORMED DEN DA OTHER. UNDER ADVERSE SELECTION A UNIFORM PRICE IZ SET FROM DA AVERAGE QUALITY, SELLERS OF ABOVE-AVERAGE GOODS WITHDRAW, DA AVERAGE FALLS AN' DA MARKET UNRAVELS TOWARD ITS WORST SEGMENT. UNDER SIGNALLIN' DA UNINFORMED PARTY INFERS QUALITY FROM AN OBSERVABLE ACTION DAT IZ CHEAPER FOR DA HIGH TYPE, SO A CREDENTIAL SEPARATES DA TYPES BY BEING COSTLY AN' NEED NOT BE PRODUCTIVE. UNDER SCREENIN' DA INFORMED PARTY IZ SORTED BY DA MENU OF CONTRACTS IT IZ OFFERED, AS WIT A DEDUCTIBLE. NONE OF DA THREE SEPARATIN' EQUILIBRIA IZ PARETO EFFICIENT!

soc_prospect.name: PROSPECT THEORY IN ECONOMICS
soc_prospect.desc: CHOICE IZ MODELLED OVER GAINS AN' LOSSES FROM A REFERENCE POINT INSTEAD OF OVER FINAL WEALTH. DA VALUE FUNCTION IZ CONCAVE ABOVE DA REFERENCE POINT, CONVEX BELOW IT AN' STEEPER BELOW BY A FACTOR NEAR 2.25, SO AN IDENTICAL PROSPECT IZ ACCEPTED WHEN FRAMED AS A GAIN AN' REFUSED WHEN FRAMED AS A LOSS. PROBABILITIES ENTER THROUGH A WEIGHTIN' FUNCTION DAT OVERWEIGHTS OUTCOMES BELOW ABOUT 0.35 AN' UNDERWEIGHTS DA REST, WHICH REPRODUCES SIMULTANEOUS DEMAND FOR INSURANCE AN' LOTTERY TICKETS. DA PARAMETERS IZ ESTIMATED FROM CHOICE DATA AN' REPLICATE ACROSS POPULATIONS, AN' DA FRAMIN' EFFECT SURVIVES INCENTIVES AN' EXPERTISE!

soc_social_graph.name: DA SOCIAL GRAPH
soc_social_graph.desc: AFFILIATION IZ STORED AS A GRAPH WIT TYPED EDGES AN' ATTRIBUTE VECTORS ON DA NODES, AN' QUERIED BY TRAVERSAL INSTEAD OF BY JOIN, SO DEGREE DISTRIBUTION, CLUSTERIN' COEFFICIENT, PATH LENGTH AN' COMMUNITY PARTITION OF A WHOLE POPULATION BECOME COMPUTABLE IN A SINGLE PASS. DA SAME ADJACENCY DAT SUPPORTS DA QUERY SUPPORTS DA INFERENCE!

soc_collective.name: COLLECTIVE INTELLIGENCE
soc_collective.desc: AN ENCYCLOPAEDIA WRITTEN UNDER OPEN EDITIN', WIT FULL REVISION HISTORY, A PER-PAGE DISCUSSION RECORD AN' A REVERT DAT COSTS ONE CLICK AGAINST DA SEVERAL MINUTES A DEFACEMENT COSTS. ACCURACY IZ UNEVENLY DISTRIBUTED: IT TRACKS TRAFFIC, AN' DA LONG TAIL OF LOW-TRAFFIC PAGES IZ UNAUDITED!

soc_microfinance.name: MICROFINANCE
soc_microfinance.desc: UNCOLLATERALISED LOANS OF TENS OF DOLLARS IZ EXTENDED TA BORROWERS WIT NO CREDIT HISTORY, UNDERWRITTEN BY JOINT LIABILITY WITHIN GROUPS OF FIVE, WEEKLY REPAYMENT MEETINGS AN' DA PROMISE OF A LARGER LOAN ON COMPLETION. GROUP LIABILITY TRANSFERS SCREENIN' AN' ENFORCEMENT TA DA BORROWERS, WHO KNOW EACH OTHER'S PROSPECTS BETTER DEN DA LENDER DOES. REPORTED RECOVERY RUNS ABOVE 95 PERCENT AT RATES FAR BELOW DA INFORMAL MONEYLENDER'S. RANDOMISED EVALUATIONS LATER FIND DURABLE EFFECTS ON BUSINESS INVESTMENT AN' ON DA TIMIN' OF CONSUMPTION, AN' NO MEASURABLE EFFECT ON HOUSEHOLD INCOME, SCHOOLIN' OR HEALTH!

soc_smartphone.name: DA SMARTPHONE ERA
soc_smartphone.desc: A CAPACITIVE MULTITOUCH PANEL, AN ARM SYSTEM ON A CHIP, A PACKET DATA RADIO HELD PERMANENTLY ATTACHED, SATELLITE POSITIONIN', AN ACCELEROMETER AN' A CAMERA IN A DEVICE CARRIED AGAINST DA BODY, WIT A SIGNED APPLICATION CHANNEL ABOVE DEM. soc_gfc.name: SYSTEMIC RISK LAID BARE
soc_gfc.desc: MORTGAGE POOLS IZ TRANCHED INTO SECURITIES WHOSE SENIOR RATINGS REST ON AN ASSUMED DEFAULT CORRELATION, CALIBRATED ON A NATIONAL PRICE SERIES DAT CONTAINS NO NATIONWIDE DECLINE. DA DIVERSIFICATION WAZ AN ARTEFACT OF DA ESTIMATION WINDOW!

soc_nudge.name: NUDGE AN' CHOICE ARCHITECTURE
soc_nudge.desc: DEFAULTS, ORDERIN', SALIENCE AN' FRAMIN' IZ TREATED AS DESIGN PARAMETERS OF DA CHOICE ENVIRONMENT, ON DA FINDIN' DAT DEY MOVE AGGREGATE BEHAVIOUR WHILE LEAVIN' DA OPTION SET UNCHANGED. soc_commons.name: GOVERNIN' DA COMMONS
soc_commons.desc: FIELD STUDIES OF IRRIGATION SYSTEMS, INSHORE FISHERIES, PASTURES AN' FORESTS DOCUMENT COMMON-POOL RESOURCES GOVERNED DURABLY WITHOUT STATE ALLOCATION OR PRIVATE TITLE. DA TRAGEDY OF DA COMMONS IZ THEREBY DEMOTED FROM A THEOREM TA ONE OUTCOME AMONG SEVERAL!

soc_big_data.name: BIG DATA AN' DA QUANTIFIED SELF
soc_big_data.desc: CLICKSTREAMS, LOCATION TRACES, TRANSACTION RECORDS AN' SENSOR LOGS IZ JOINED ON SHARED IDENTIFIERS AN' FITTED WIT REGRESSION AN' CLASSIFICATION MODELS. soc_networked_movement.name: NETWORKED SOCIAL MOVEMENTS
soc_networked_movement.desc: COORDINATION SHIFTS FROM STANDIN' ORGANISATIONS ONTO MOBILE MESSAGIN' AN' PUBLIC FEEDS. DA COST OF CALLIN' AN ASSEMBLY FALLS TA NEAR ZERO, DA INTERVAL BETWEEN CALL AN' GATHERIN' DROPS FROM WEEKS TA HOURS, AN' DERE IZ NO COMMITTEE WHOSE ARREST ENDS DA MOBILISATION. soc_mooc.name: OPEN ONLINE EDUCATION
soc_mooc.desc: A COURSE IZ PACKAGED AS SEGMENTED RECORDED VIDEO, AUTOMATICALLY GRADED ASSESSMENT AN' CALIBRATED PEER REVIEW, SO DA MARGINAL COST OF AN ADDITIONAL STUDENT APPROACHES ZERO AN' A SINGLE ENROLMENT REACHES SIX FIGURES. DA BINDIN' CONSTRAINT MOVES FROM LECTURE HALL CAPACITY TA FEEDBACK: AUTOMATIC GRADIN' COVERS WHAT CAN BE MACHINE-CHECKED, PEER REVIEW COVERS DA REST AT A RELIABILITY DAT HAB TA BE ESTIMATED AN' CORRECTED FOR!

soc_the_secret.name: DA LAW OF ATTRACTION
soc_the_secret.desc: A PROTOCOL OF VISUALISATION, AFFIRMATION AN' GRATITUDE, ON A STATED MECHANISM OF VIBRATIONAL RESONANCE BY WHICH THOUGHT ATTRACTS A MATCHIN' OUTCOME. soc_vaccine_panic.name: DA VACCINE-AUTISM PANIC
soc_vaccine_panic.desc: A CASE SERIES OF TWELVE CHILDREN REPORTS BOWEL FINDINGS AN' DEVELOPMENTAL REGRESSION, AN' PROPOSES A TEMPORAL LINK TA A COMBINED VACCINE. soc_precognition.name: FEELIN' DA FUTURE
soc_precognition.desc: NINE EXPERIMENTS REVERSE DA ORDER OF STANDARD PARADIGMS, TESTIN' WHETHER A STIMULUS PRESENTED AFTER A RESPONSE CAN AFFECT IT, AN' REPORT RETROACTIVE PRIMIN' AN' REVERSED PRACTICE EFFECTS AT AN AVERAGE EFFECT SIZE NEAR 0.2. soc_mobile_web.name: DA MOBILE WEB

soc_cloud.name: CLOUD COMPUTIN'

soc_video_platform.name: UBIQUITOUS VIDEO STREAMIN'
